system.requirements: One willing ally within 15 feet can hear your brief encouraging performance.
system.effect:
Attempt a Performance check against a Threshold set by the GM (typically 15), with the following effects:
Critical Success The ally gains a +2 Situation bonus to their next Defense against a Fear effect until the end of the next round.
Success The ally gains a +1 Situation bonus to their next Defense against a Fear effect until the end of the next round.
Failure or Critical Failure No effect.
